comments.quote: 這裏空氣是真的比城市裡好，沒有污染，天空是一望無際的藍，很美，晚上還能看到星星，來這裏遊玩的人也確實很多，還挺喜歡這裏的生活的，有人間煙火氣.偶爾來旅遊一次還是不錯的.
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The air here really is better than in a city, with no pollution, and the sky is blue as far as you can see. Beautiful. You can see the stars at night. A lot of people come, and I rather like the life of the place. Once in a while it makes a very good trip.
